SELECT i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county, avg(cast(cs_quantity as decimal(12,2))) agg1, avg(cast(cs_list_price as decimal(12,2))) agg2, avg(cast(cs_coupon_amt as decimal(12,2))) agg3, avg(cast(cs_sales_price as decimal(12,2))) agg4, avg(cast(cs_net_profit as decimal(12,2))) agg5, avg(cast(c_birth_year as decimal(12,2))) agg6, avg(cast(cd1.cd_dep_count as decimal(12,2))) agg7 
FROM catalog_sales JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2001 
JOIN item ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk 
JOIN customer_demographics cd1 ON cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk AND cd1.cd_gender = 'F' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary' 
JOIN (SELECT * FROM customer JOIN customer_address ON c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk) AS s2 ON s2.c_customer_sk = cs_bill_customer_sk AND s2.ca_state IN ('AL','MO','TN' ,'GA','MT','IN','CA')
WHERE s2.c_birth_month IN (1,3,7,11,10,4) 
GROUP BY i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county ORDER BY ca_country, ca_state, ca_county, i_item_id LIMIT 100
